tier.rationale: Overall T4 (provisional: citations pending US-MQ-04, US-MQ-10 and US-MQ-20..70). Employer-operation test: T4 requires a second independent calculation AND a separate remittance/return to a second authority. The employer computes federal income-tax withholding, FICA and FUTA for the IRS (Forms 941/940, W-2), and in every state that taxes wages computes a SEPARATE state withholding under that state's own tables/certificate and remits it to the state revenue department on a state return; state unemployment insurance is likewise a separate calculation on a separate quarterly report to a state agency. Nothing is absorbed into the federal deduction (contrast Switzerland, StHG Art. 36a Abs. 1, where one deduction discharges all levels). This is the Quebec pattern repeated for up to 51 jurisdictions, plus a local layer (city/county/school district) that is T4 where remitted separately and T3 where piggybacked on the state return. Consequence: the federal core and each jurisdiction are declared and scoped as parallel layers, and the multistate domain routes each employee to one or more of them. No US instrument is on disk yet; the candidate instruments to confirm are IRC chapter 24 (federal withholding), chapters 21/23 (FICA/FUTA) and each state's withholding and UI statutes.

_by_domain_reasons.federal_income_tax: One authority (IRS), progressive tables, one certificate (W-4); NRA and supplemental regimes sit inside one calculation.
_by_domain_reasons.fica_social_security_medicare: Federal, uniform rates, one authority; wage base indexed (US-MQ-06).
_by_domain_reasons.futa: Federal return, but the effective rate depends on the state UI credit and credit-reduction states: a cross-layer dependency (US-MQ-04).
_by_domain_reasons.state_income_tax: Second independent calculation plus a separate return to a second authority (state DoR) in every wage-taxing state; T1 ('none') in states without wage tax, which states pending per jurisdiction.
_by_domain_reasons.local_income_tax: T4 where a locality/collector receives a separate return; T3 where piggybacked on the state return. Mixed per state, pending US-MQ-20..70.
_by_domain_reasons.state_unemployment_insurance: Separate state agency, separate quarterly wage report and remittance; employer experience rate is per-employer master data.
_by_domain_reasons.sdi_tdi_pfml: T4 where a separate agency/return exists, T3 where filed with UI, data-problem where funded through a private insurer. Does not uniformly meet the discriminator.
_by_domain_reasons.workers_compensation: Mostly insurer premiums outside payroll; payroll-deducted only in some state-fund states. Variability axis is the insurer/state fund, not a statutory rate table (US-MQ-05).
_by_domain_reasons.multistate: Routing layer that selects which T4 jurisdictions apply per employee (work state, residence state, reciprocity, convenience rule, SUI localization), US-MQ-10.
_by_domain_reasons.labour_code: Federal floor (FLSA) plus state wage-payment rules; one calculation, state-keyed fields.
_by_domain_reasons.payslip_statute: No federal pay-statement mandate assumed; state-by-state content rules (US-MQ-03).
_by_domain_reasons.statutory_reporting: Federal 941/940/W-2 plus per-state withholding, reconciliation, UI and local returns; submitted via third-party provider (US-MQ-09).
_by_domain_reasons.leave: State and local paid-sick-leave rules, state/locality-keyed.
_by_domain_reasons.benefits_in_kind: Federal fringe rules; state conformity is data.
_by_domain_reasons.deductions_garnishments: Federal CCPA limits plus state variations.
_by_domain_reasons.collective_agreements: Provisional: no sector extension mechanism assumed, pending US-MQ-07.
_by_domain_reasons.indexation: Annual federal Revenue Procedure + SSA wage base + state wage-base indexation (US-MQ-06 and per state).
_by_domain_reasons.live_legal_change: 53 parameter sets (federal + multistate + 51) change every year.
